notes:
What's new in 0.1.79:
• Fixed a few security problems we found ourselves. Details are kept private.
• "Stream once" with others now needs the server's yes. TV links, viewer links and library guests cannot start it.
• The Admin web pages and their activity lists are now in Spanish, French, German, Portuguese (Brazil) and Italian.
• The Movies and TV pages in a web browser are translated.
• Guest pages are translated: phone speakers, Movie Night and the walkie-talkie.
• The Surprise, Upload and trip-share pages are translated. A trip-share page opens in the viewer's language.
• Settings search and six sidebar labels are now translated.
• German now uses the formal "Sie". Portuguese (Brazil) now says "o Beebo".
• Music radio: a quick "Next song" press no longer refills the wrong station.
• Network-folder error messages are correct on Linux and Mac.
• Sign-in now only uses Beebo's own address. You should not notice any change.
• New translations are machine-assisted and not yet read by a native speaker.
• The installer is not code-signed.
• Built from commit 28a777a1, Oct 5, 2026, 4:56 AM Eastern.
